description: RightMotion Machine-Readable Component Capability Index. Maps semantic narrative concepts to concrete Remotion components.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Show increasing physical compression, strain, or cognitive burden on an environment or subject

components.name: ViscoelasticDeformation
components.limitations: Best for continuous progressive strain rather than sudden snaps
components.restraintGuidance: Use when one structure needs to visibly deform under load. Do NOT combine with multiple competing diagrams, dials, or cards. Let the single deforming body be the primary focal event.

components.name: KineticTensionDial
components.limitations: Rotational meter; combine with open-stage mechanics
components.restraintGuidance: Use as a minimal secondary gauge when rotational magnitude is essential. Do NOT pair with complex physical simulations.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Show structural failure, cleavage, or reaching a breaking point under unsustainable tension

components.name: StressFractureEngine
components.limitations: Requires trigger frame to initiate fissure growth
components.restraintGuidance: Use for progressive structural cleavage. Ensure the fracture happens live on screen without competing background animations.

components.name: AnimatedSlashStrike
components.limitations: Single-impact strike line; best for text negation or line severance
components.restraintGuidance: Use for instant cognitive negation or severance. Deliver with a single clean whoosh/impact sound.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Show elements piling up, stacking, or crossing a storage/capacity threshold

components.name: CausalWorld
components.limitations: Requires upfront causal graph definition in JSON
components.performanceNotes: Compiled deterministic timeline; binary search O(log E)
components.restraintGuidance: Use for multi-step causal propagation chains. Keep node visuals minimal; avoid combining with external floating cards.

components.name: DynamicSankeyFlow
components.limitations: Represents flow distribution rather than physical mass
components.restraintGuidance: Use when the core idea is resource redistribution or dopamine routing. Do not clutter with auxiliary metric readouts.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Show standards receding, boundaries shifting, or lines being crossed

components.name: ThresholdBoundary
components.limitations: Renders open-stage horizontal datum line
components.performanceNotes: Zero box cardification; open SVG surface
components.restraintGuidance: Open-stage datum line. Excellent minimal metaphor for receding standards. Keep surrounding negative space generous.

components.name: ThresholdBoundaryShift
components.limitations: Animates a step change in acceptable tolerance
components.restraintGuidance: Spring-interpolated baseline mutation. Use as the sole visual subject during a tolerance reset.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Show repeated actions wearing down resistance or carving a permanent channel

components.name: KineticFurrow
components.limitations: Vertical linear carved channel
components.performanceNotes: Multi-layer inset shadow with SVG groove
components.restraintGuidance: Carved linear habit groove. Do NOT surround with multiple cards or text labels; the depth of the groove communicates the habit.

components.name: ResistancePathway
components.limitations: Visualizes low-friction vs high-friction pathways
components.performanceNotes: Pure SVG path stroke dash animation
components.restraintGuidance: High vs low friction pathways. Keep geometry clean and centered.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Show conflicting priorities, asymmetric investment, or loss of equilibrium

components.name: KineticFulcrumBeam
components.limitations: Physical seesaw lever mechanism
components.performanceNotes: Hardware-accelerated CSS rotation around central pivot
components.restraintGuidance: Seesaw lever tradeoff. Keep masses clear and uncrowded.

components.name: GlossyBalanceScale
components.limitations: Higher-level editorial styling
components.restraintGuidance: Editorial balance comparison. Limit text to concise anchor words on either pan.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Navigate across distinct spatial coordinates on a continuous canvas without cutting

components.name: InfiniteWorldCanvas
components.limitations: Requires defining world entities at explicit (x, y) coordinates
components.performanceNotes: Single matrix transform wrapping virtual coordinates
components.restraintGuidance: Spatial journey. Ensure only one chamber is active at a time to prevent eye confusion.

components.name: CameraCanvas
components.limitations: 2.5D After Effects camera rig; best with keyframed focus targets
components.performanceNotes: Matrix translation + scale with procedural breathing wiggle
components.restraintGuidance: Camera drift/zoom rig. Movement should be subtle (1.0 to 1.05); never overwhelm the primary subject.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Create pregnant pauses, visual stillness, or dramatic micro-freezes before key revelations

components.name: WorldCameraBreathHold
components.limitations: Should only be used when narration pauses for profound realization
components.restraintGuidance: Dramatic stillness hold before epiphany. Zero velocity clamp.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Show consequences that cannot be undone, leaving permanent markings or scars

components.name: CapillaryInkBleed
components.limitations: Radial fluid percolation effect
components.restraintGuidance: Irreversible fluid percolation or stain. Best on pristine light ground.

components.name: PersistentMemoryStage
components.limitations: Preserves visual ghosting into subsequent scenes
components.restraintGuidance: Faint ghost trace of earlier baseline. Keep opacity low (0.15-0.25).

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Highlight breakthrough realizations, decisive action, or cutting through confusion

components.name: KineticHighlighter
components.limitations: Underlines or highlights a single focus word/phrase
components.restraintGuidance: Draws stroke behind single focus word. Do not highlight full sentences.

components.name: CameraShake
components.limitations: Short camera shockwave (10-15 frames)
components.restraintGuidance: Short 8-12 frame impact shockwave. Use only on peak realization beat.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Host engagement on small mobile screens with proper bottom-bezel grounding

components.name: GlossyJudyIntro
components.limitations: Strictly grounded to bottom bezel (waist-up 1250-1360px)
components.performanceNotes: High-res PNG with reflection and spring entrance
components.restraintGuidance: Grounded host connection. Stage in opening 2.5s hook. Remove when mechanical metaphor begins.

components.name: CharacterKeyframeAnimator
components.limitations: Multi-beat character keyframing across time intervals
components.restraintGuidance: Multi-beat character poses. Avoid simultaneous moving props.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Guide viewer attention, build psychological tension with slow pushes, or punch impact with rotational tilts and shakes
capabilities.mobileScaleGuidance: Camera movement must remain subtle (zoom 1.0 to 1.05-1.08) in 9:16 vertical shorts. Keep subject centered within the 1080x1920 canvas.

components.name: CameraCanvas
components.limitations: 2.5D After Effects camera rig; define keyframes across timeMs. In 9:16 vertical shorts, pass width={1080} height={1920}
components.performanceNotes: Matrix translation + scale with procedural breathing wiggle
components.restraintGuidance: Camera drift/zoom rig. Movement should be subtle (1.0 to 1.06); never overwhelm the primary subject.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Punctuate mechanical contact points, state changes, threshold breaches, and resolution snaps with tactile frame-accurate sound
capabilities.mobileScaleGuidance: Audio cues reinforce visual size and weight at phone speaker volumes.

components.name: SoundDesignEngine
components.limitations: Requires array of frame-synchronized cues (click, whoosh_fast, whoosh_deep, whoosh_sparkle, impact_hit, tape_snap, marker_scribble)
components.restraintGuidance: Punctuate key mechanical contact points and transitions. Do NOT wallpaper every frame with noise.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Provide calibrated platform-safe bounds (y: 280 to 1340px) for open physical mechanisms with zero box cardification
capabilities.mobileScaleGuidance: Full 1080px horizontal span with safe clearance above captions (y: 1340px).

components.name: MechanismStage
components.limitations: Open stage container for physical mechanisms
components.performanceNotes: Zero box cardification; pure open staging space
components.restraintGuidance: Default staging ground for all physical mechanisms. Clears header and captions automatically.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: Deliver volume-preserving squash and stretch, inertial follow-through, and chronic strain tremors
capabilities.mobileScaleGuidance: Deformations and tremors must be large enough to perceive on mobile (4px-8px deflection/rebound).

components.name: SquashAndStretch
components.limitations: Best on impact and launch frames
components.restraintGuidance: Use on impact frames for tactile elasticity. Do not run continuously.

capabilities.semanticPurpose: DEPRECATED: Banned by Zero Memes Policy (§Rule 4). Retained only for audit traceability.

components.name: TacticalMemeCard
components.reason: Opening video memes strictly banned by Zero Memes Policy
components.replacement: Use CinematicIllustrationCard with bespoke AI illustration or open-stage physical primitives
components.restraintGuidance: STRICTLY BANNED by Zero Memes Policy (§Rule 4).

components.name: TacticalMemeFrame
components.restraintGuidance: STRICTLY BANNED by Zero Memes Policy (§Rule 4).

components.name: MemeStickerOverlay
components.replacement: Use high-res semantic cutouts from public/assets/
components.restraintGuidance: STRICTLY BANNED by Zero Memes Policy (§Rule 4).

principlesOfRestraint: Prefer one evolving object or system over many separate objects.
suggestedComponents are MUTUALLY OPTIONAL tools, NOT ingredients. Component budget defaults to 1 (max 2).
Never combine multiple complex visual systems simultaneously without clear temporal hierarchy.
If the motion of one physical object communicates the sentence, stop adding secondary elements.
Negative space is a feature. Do not fill empty canvas space with unmotivated particles, cards, or metrics.
SIMPLE FRAME != SMALL VISUALS. Primary visual subject must occupy 400px-750px with 6px-14px strokes for instant mobile recognition.
